author: GamingBolt
description:
Thanks to its narrative focus and strong mission pacing, DarkSwitch does an excellent job of alternating between tense survival-driven stretches and quieter moments where you can appreciate the city you’ve built. 

Its tutorial interruptions and occasional building friction hold it back, but this is still an easy recommendation for city-builder fans and a strong one for newcomers willing to learn its systems.
title: Darkswitch Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Carcosa, Atropos, the Gungeon – for any fan of bullet hell rogue-lites/likes, they're all fancy names for a shifting playground of pain, where death is one of two constants. 

Whether you're used to the genre or not, getting a handle on the various mechanics and twists that Housemarque's Saros offers can take some time. But remember the second constant: Death is never the end. Here's how to survive the early hours of Carcosa and perhaps even bend it to your will.
title: Saros - 15 Beginners Tips And Tricks It Doesn't Tell You

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert feels like an entirely new game after a bunch of patches have transformed its rather shaky release build into a solid open world game that has you pouring hours into everything Pywel has to offer. But of course, there are still things that would make the whole thing look and feel even better if they were to be added to the game.

There's no dearth of ideas when it comes to potential additions to such a game, but we distilled the ones we think would work best with the kind of experience it aims to give you. Join us as we take you through potential additions to Pywel that can make it an even better open world sandbox than it already is.
title: Crimson Desert Needs These 15 Additions ASAP
